paragraph: The PRD never names the table account_return_daily and states no outcome for it. What it does state is FWD-3: an analyst reads each Cottonwood account's returns day by day, after fees, back to 2013, and C-DAILY says how those days are built (holdings rebuilt from transactions, valued with a closing price, a daily after-fee time-weighted return with the day's flows taken out). Neither FWD-3, C-DAILY, the manifest row S10 nor either v0.4 addendum uses the word income or says income is in or out of the returns. So no sentence states an outcome for the table, and none includes income; the answer is NOT_STATED rather than NO, because NO needs an outcome for the table that is stated and leaves income out. The requirement to mint the table came from outside this PRD: round 38 was cut on the CTO's ADDENDUM 11.2, an enrichment item from IRPT_DASHBD, whose FWD-12 needs the table; the adapter itself says FWD-3 does not separate income (it sits inside the value through the cash leg) and writes income_received and income_return as NULL.
